name: HTMLPDFGenerator
label: HTML PDF Generator
description: Utility connector that converts HTML or Rich Text content into a standalone PDF file on the FortiSOAR appliance. Supports page size, orientation and margins, and automatically falls back between wkhtmltopdf, Chromium, Pandoc and LibreOffice.

operations.title: Build PDF Document
operations.description: Converts HTML or Rich Text content into a PDF file and returns its path so the next playbook step can attach or upload it.

parameters.title: Data for PDF
parameters.name: dataForPDF
parameters.tooltip: HTML or Rich Text content to convert. A fragment is automatically wrapped in a full HTML document.
parameters.description: HTML or Rich Text content to convert. HTML fragments are wrapped in a full UTF-8 document automatically; JSON objects are rendered as formatted text.

parameters.title: File Name
parameters.name: fileName
parameters.tooltip: Name of the generated file. The .pdf extension is added if missing.
parameters.description: Name of the generated PDF file. Unsafe characters are replaced with underscores and the .pdf extension is added if missing.

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.tooltip: Paper size of the generated PDF.
parameters.description: Paper size of the generated PDF.

parameters.title: Orientation
parameters.name: orientation
parameters.tooltip: Page orientation of the generated PDF.
parameters.description: Page orientation of the generated PDF.

parameters.title: Margin
parameters.name: margin
parameters.tooltip: Page margin applied to all sides, e.g. 20mm, 2cm or 0.75in.
parameters.description: Page margin applied to all four sides. Use a number followed by mm, cm or in (e.g. 20mm, 2cm, 0.75in).

parameters.title: Conversion Engine
parameters.name: engine
parameters.tooltip: Rendering engine. Auto tries every installed engine in order until one succeeds.
parameters.description: Rendering engine to use. Auto tries wkhtmltopdf, Chromium, Pandoc and LibreOffice in that order and uses the first one that succeeds. Choose Chromium for the best modern CSS support.

parameters.title: Timeout (seconds)
parameters.name: timeout
parameters.tooltip: Maximum time allowed for each engine attempt (1-900).
parameters.description: Maximum number of seconds allowed for each engine attempt (1-900).

parameters.title: Allow Local File Access
parameters.name: allowLocalFileAccess
parameters.tooltip: Allow the HTML to load local files (e.g. images under /tmp). Keep disabled for untrusted content.
parameters.description: Allows the HTML to reference files on the FortiSOAR appliance (for example file:///tmp/logo.png) when using wkhtmltopdf. Keep disabled when the HTML may contain untrusted data such as alert or email content.
